info.album: Telstar / Jungle Fever (2026 New Stereo Mix)

podcast.body: A surf-like instrumental capitalizing on excitement around the launch of the Telstar communications satellite. It became the second British song to reach number one on the US charts and sold over 5 million copies worldwide. George Bellamy, Matt Bellamy's father, played rhythm guitar on the recording for producer Joe Meek. "It sold well over 5 million copies worldwide."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Interpreted by The Tornados, this instrumental track became their biggest success in 1962 and achieved a significant milestone: it was the first British song to reach number one in the United States. This accomplishment predated the full force of the British Invasion, marking a pivotal moment for British music on the international stage. "En 1962 produce su mayor éxito, Del Star, interpretada por detornados. La canción fue todo unito al convertirse en el primer número 1 en Estados Unidos, proveniente de Inglaterra, adelantándose también a la British Invasion."

srcs.episode: El productor que escuchó el nuevo mundo. Joe Meek.

podcast.body: This instrumental track was notable for being the first UK band to achieve a number one hit on the American singles charts. It was released in 1962. "It was an instrumental called Tellstar."
